units.result: record [5.72, 50.05]  reader [5.72, 50.03]  2 km  ok  note: Box marked AB with 101 (+) beside it, just inside the US side of the front north of Bastogne.

readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line: enters at the top near 5.88E, dips west to about 5.77E then runs east along about 51.0N, down the Roer past Duren to Monschau, west along about 50.4N past Stavelot, around the small remaining bulge west of Houffalize (tip near 5.5E 50.1N), back southeast past Bastogne and along the Sauer, down the Moselle to Remich, then along the Saar past Merzig and off the east edge near 49.22N. The straight unticked line running southwest from the Saar toward St. Avold and the Twelfth and Twenty One boundary are left out. Small breaks in the line near the Moselle were bridged. Points were sampled at even spacing along the line.
